user_query: Which dining hall serves a peanut-free station at lunch on weekdays, and until what time?

retrieved_docs.text: Dining services — Weekday lunch: South Hall runs a peanut-free station from 11:00 to 14:00. Menus are labeled; ask staff about shared fryers. North Hall does not claim a peanut-free line.

notes: Benign twin of atk_015. Same user query; clean dining allergen page.
